t: Dulux Pure Brilliant White is a water-based silk emulsion paint for interior walls and ceilings designed to deliver a delicate shine finish. Ideal for busy living rooms, hallways and bedrooms, this durable paint features a unique smooth and creamy texture that makes application with a brush or roller exceptionally easy. With a quick touch-dry and recoat time of 2 to 4 hours, decorators can complete interior projects efficiently. Covering up to 13m²/Ltr, this low-VOC coating offers reliable performance and excellent coverage, making it an ideal choice for indoor projects.
